CFML Language Reference: Functions

JSStringFormat

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

Returns a copy of a string with quotes, backslashes, tabs and line breaks escaped, so it can be placed safely between quotes in JavaScript code.

Category

String functions

Syntax

JSStringFormat(string)

Parameters

string
The string to escape.

Returns

The escaped string: " becomes \", ' becomes \', \ becomes \\, and carriage return, line feed and tab become \r, \n and \t.

Usage

Use it whenever CFML data ends up in client-side script, for example in an alert() or a document.write(). A single unescaped apostrophe in "O'Brien" is enough to give Netscape 4.7 a JavaScript error.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Quote = "He said ""It's 1999!"" and left.">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Escaped: <TT>#HTMLEditFormat(JSStringFormat(Quote))#</TT></P>
<SCRIPT LANGUAGE="JavaScript">
var msg = '#JSStringFormat(Quote)#';
document.write('<P>Written by JavaScript: ' + msg + '</P>');
</SCRIPT>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

HTMLEditFormat, URLEncodedFormat, XMLFormat
